placement_policy: Translate one canonical true mask and its erroneous masks to each location without clipping. Reject the entire identity/area group if any translated mask leaves the image. Never silently clamp a semantic center.
scope: Synthetic development geometry diagnostic using existing validation identities. Eye and mouth labels locate centers only; upper_image is an image-coordinate control and need not be background. No real-occluder or identity-fidelity claim.
